Chapter 928: Chapter 24 Shattered (Returning Tomorrow, Requesting Monthly Votes At The Start Of The Month For Guaranteed Minimum)

Chapter 928: Chapter 24 Shattered (Returning tomorrow, requesting monthly votes at the start of the month for guaranteed minimum)

Compared to a thousand years ago.

At this moment, the ‘egg’ formed by the nurturing of countless rules within the world inside his body has already solidified into a substantial form. Even Lin Yuan can feel the vast fluctuations within the ‘egg’.

“What is being nurtured inside should be the Chaos Rule.”

Lin Yuan gazed at the towering gigantic ‘egg’, thinking to himself.

In a certain sense, this ‘egg’ is the Tao Fruit that he has been comprehending for a thousand years, or to be precise, the culmination of his comprehension of many rules up to now.

With the towering gigantic ‘egg’ fully materialized, it means that Lin Yuan is infinitely close to grasping the Chaos Rule.

At least now, the Chaos Rule, for Lin Yuan, is no longer elusive but tangible, much like the ‘egg’ within the world inside his body.

“The Chaos Rule…” Lin Yuan sighed inwardly.

No wonder comprehending the Chaos Rule at level eleven is the stuff of legends within legends; even for beings of Xuanhuang Majesty’s and Moyu Tower Master’s caliber, they’ve only heard of it and never actually witnessed it in the Chaos Void.

Because attaining comprehension of the Chaos Rule at level eleven is indeed too difficult.

Lin Yuan, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding and the Myriad Realms Gate, was able to traverse and descend upon the myriad worlds, taking advantage of the differences between various dimensions, as well as the opportunities of each world, to finally reach this step.

As for other level eleven beings? To comprehend the Chaos Rule, how many detours would they have to take? How many resources would they have to exhaust?

“Perhaps a Chaos Realm powerhouse demonstrating the complete Chaos Rule might be somewhat helpful for comprehending the Chaos Rule.” Lin Yuan silently pondered.

Chaos Realm entities at level twelve have basically comprehended the Chaos Rule, and can fully manifest the Chaos Rule they have comprehended.

But manifesting it and making a level eleven lifeform comprehend it are entirely two different matters.

The universe is replete with infinite mysteries in the heavens and the Chaos Void; but in the end, how many lives can reach the ultimate limit?

…

“Ninth Stage Martial Tao First Tier Chapter…”

Bits and pieces about the First Tier Chapter floated through Lin Yuan’s mind.

Ninth Stage Martial Tao First Tier Chapter… Lin Yuan began attempting its creation while still at stage ten and officially started perfecting it upon stepping into level eleven.

However, it was only in the recent decades, by utilizing the countless rules at the core of the Primordial Lands of the Immortal Realm, that Lin Yuan finally managed to complete the Ninth Stage Martial Tao First Tier Chapter.

The Ninth Stage Martial Tao First Tier Chapter represents the ultimate leap, the final realm, and serves as an aggregate sublimation of the previous ten realms.

The First Tier Chapter developed by Lin Yuan is rooted in the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, and specifically constructs 33,333 spatiotemporal models ranging from the First to Fifth Realm of space-time.

The rule models are the way evolutionary scholars of human civilization extract and describe the cosmic laws in an easy-to-understand model.

Just like various physical and mathematical formulas? Initially, these formulas didn’t exist; they were all summarized by those great scientists through continuous calculations.

It’s the same for rule models.

They are the result of painstaking efforts by the evolutionary scholars of human civilization, who derived them from the most fundamental rules of the universe.

The foundational space rule model, core space rule model, and the time rule model that Lin Yuan first comprehended are such cases.

However, evolutionary scholars of human civilization have their limits in terms of understanding, at most, they have only summarized thousands of time rule models.

And even if one comprehends all these thousands of time rule models, they would still be far from completely grasping the Rule of Time.

The rule models that human civilization has developed and mastered are limited to time rule models.

As for further spatiotemporal rule models? They simply cannot be materialized.

This isn’t because these evolutionary scholars of human civilization are withholding secrets, but rather their level of understanding is limited.

Lin Yuan is different. With his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, his perception of the rules quickly surpassed the sum total of all of human civilization’s evolutionary scholars.

And this time, his experience in the Immortal Realm, especially the insights gained at the heart of the Primordial Lands, has elevated his understanding of the rules to an unprecedented level.

Utilizing the insights from the millions of Pillar-level Fusion Rules outside the Sixth Realm of space-time, he finally succeeded in constructing the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule model, covering the First to Fifth Realms of space-time.

Bear in mind that establishing corresponding rule models is an entirely different concept from fully comprehending those rules.

Among human civilization, there are Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers who have reached the Fifth Realm in their understanding of space-time, but not a single one has managed to construct, not even a single realm’s, spatiotemporal fusion rule model.

The nine ultimate powerhouses are the same; their comprehension of the spatiotemporal fusion rules has reached the Sixth Realm, but to construct a space-time comprehension model applicable to all evolvers is still as difficult as ascending to the heavens.

Apart from the spatiotemporal fusion rule models, Lin Yuan has also added some other rule models within the Ninth Stage Martial Tao First Tier Chapter.

These rule models are special rules that Lin Yuan perfected and developed in his spare time.

“The 33,333 spatiotemporal fusion rule models will make future Martial Arts Evolutionaries’ comprehension of space-time a bit easier.”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

These tens of thousands of spatiotemporal fusion rule models can also be used by other evolutionary paths, but they work best for Martial Arts Evolutionaries.

Of course, even with a clear rule model for reference, comprehending all the space-time rule models is no easy task.

…

[Name: Gao Wuyou (Lin Yuan)]

[Status: Holder of the Myriad Realms Gate]

[Innate Talent: Against-Heaven’s Understanding]

[Divine Skills: Blood Resurrection]

[Divine Skills: Mountain Moving]

[Divine Skills: Strengthening]

[Divine Skills: Elemental Body]

[Divine Skills: World]

[Divine Skills: Sky Ripping]

[Current Status: Consciousness Descended]

[Remaining Residency Time: Ninety-eight years]

…

Lin Yuan glanced at the ethereal text below his sight.

“There are still ninety-eight years of residency time left.”

After contemplating for a moment, Lin Yuan’s figure vanished from the spot.

…

Kaiyuan Martial City.

This is the first martial city in the Immortal Realm, corresponding to the various Immortal Cities of the Immortal Path cultivation system.

For over a thousand years, the number of Martial Tao cultivators in the thirty-three Immortal Domains of the Immortal Realm has become countless, and Kaiyuan Martial City has become the sacred ground in the hearts of all Martial Tao cultivators.

Because the establishment of this Martial City was directed by the Ancestor of Martial Arts, the first city lord of Kaiyuan Martial City was also a Direct Disciple of the Martial Ancestor.

In the center of the Martial City.

The grand Martial Hall.

At the highest seat of the throne, a figure appeared silently and slowly sat down.

“Teacher.”

Li Qing below, seeming to sense something, immediately paid her excited respects to the figure on the throne.

Over a thousand years, Li Qing had met Lin Yuan only a handful of times.

“Martial Ancestor!”

Shan Yang, Nie Yun, and other Ninth Stage Martial Tao cultivators were likewise invigorated.

They all came from the Spirit Realm and had followed Lin Yuan through the realms more than once.

“All rise.”

Lin Yuan waved his hand dismissively and spoke casually.

The currently strongest in Martial Tao were none other than Li Qing and other Ninth Stage cultivators.

“This is the Eleventh Level Martial Tao Chapter.”

Lin Yuan lifted his right hand, and the intricacies of the Eleventh Level Martial Tao Chapter flooded into the minds of Li Qing and the others.

The Eleventh Level Martial Tao Chapter was not so much created by Lin Yuan as it was a replication based on his own insights, similar to those of the Ancient Gods of the Main Universe.

The evolutionary pathway of the ‘Ancient God’ propagated by the Ancient Gods is a replication of their own being.

…

When imparting the Eleventh Level Martial Tao Chapter, Lin Yuan had no concerns whatsoever.

For example, would future Martial Tao cultivators rapidly advance to Level Eleven Perfect through the Eleventh Level Martial Tao Chapter and then surpass Lin Yuan in reaching the ultimate level?

Not to mention with Lin Yuan’s rate of cultivation, whether such a thing could happen.

Even if it did happen, as long as Lin Yuan, the founder of Martial Tao, did not die, latter generations of cultivators would not be able to surpass him.

This was also a certain insight Lin Yuan had recently gained as the number of Martial Tao cultivators rapidly increased.

Any pathway of evolution or cultivation system, if the founder dies, naturally all beings under the frosted sky compete for freedom.

Any cultivator of that evolutionary pathway or cultivation system could potentially challenge the ultimate level.

But as long as the founder lives, the fundamental mark of the evolution pathway remains with the founder, overshadowing all cultivators of the same evolutionary pathway in the world.

…

“The Eleventh Level Martial Tao Chapter?”

The minds of Li Qing and the others were a muddled mess. They spent a lot of time barely digesting the Eleventh Level Martial Tao Chapter.

After all, dealing with over thirty thousand Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule models and many other rule models, it was quite strenuous for those at the Ninth Stage of Martial Tao.

If it hadn’t been for Lin Yuan actively sealing most of the content, waiting for Li Qing and the others to reach a certain realm before unsealing it, their minds and wills might have already burst.

“Teacher, this…”

After barely recovering, a hint of unease began to emerge in Li Qing’s heart.

At her level, she was far from qualified to contact the Eleventh Level Chapter. Why did Lin Yuan pass on such precious advanced paths of cultivation to her?

“Next, I will enter seclusion.”

“I estimate it will be a long time before I intervene in the affairs of the Immortal Realm.”

Lin Yuan said.

This was indeed true, there were ninety-eight years left until the end of his traversal.

During these ninety-eight years, Lin Yuan planned to retract all his mind and soul, concentrating all his energy on contemplating the rules.

Striving to comprehend the Chaos Rule before his time of stay comes to an end.

“Yes.”

Li Qing and the other Martial Tao cultivators immediately bowed in response.

…

After imparting a few more instructions.

Lin Yuan’s avatara then disappeared from the Martial Hall.

The next moment.

Lin Yuan appeared in the vast void.

This place was no longer within the Immortal Realm but instead was the vast void outside of the world.

In this void, the Immortal Realm was the undisputed highest world, with countless subordinate worlds rising and sinking below it.

“Immortal Realm?”

Lin Yuan kept ascending, gazing down upon the Immortal Realm with an overlooking stance.

In Lin Yuan’s vision, the Immortal Realm was vast and grand, a stable ‘product’ formed by the incessant interweaving and influence of myriad rules.

At the same time, another of Lin Yuan’s Primordial Spirits was within the very Origin Core of the Immortal Realm, observing the many fundamental rules of the Immortal Realm from the minutest detail.

The two combined.

As if heaven and earth collided, all things began to shatter and rebirth.

Over the past thousand years, the hundreds of thousands of rules Lin Yuan had comprehended seemed to undergo some kind of qualitative change, starting to slowly collapse and merge into one.

Thump!!!

A faint cracking sound resonated at the level of Lin Yuan’s heart and mind.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness descended to his inner world.

The towering giant ‘egg,’ formed by the interweaving of countless rules, always lying across the sky.

At some unknown time.

A crack had appeared.
